Type: rug
Name: Rivet Red Mosaic Multi-Print Wool Rug, 7'10" x 11', Red
Colors: Red
Materials: wool
Pile: 100% Wool, Backing: 100% Canvas Imported The vibrant red in this tribal print rug is sure to make a bold style statement in any room. Its intricate details and beautifully matched color palette create a bold centerpiece for neutral décor. Tribal design in red 100% wool fibers hand-tufted in India Medium, .65'' pile suits high-traffic, transitional indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 7'10" x 11' Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for fibers to settle
